title: Stevins Waterwicht
lineage: Later Dutch transcription and editorial guide to Stevin’s 1586 text, inspected at the introduction and propositions guide; 1586 is the original work date.

passages.note: Transcription and guide to 1586 text identifies propositions about buoyancy and base pressure and quotes Stevin’s acknowledgement of On Floating Bodies. This is a later web presentation of the early Dutch text.
